name: BITEZ - D8 + D9 + THCP 2000MG Gummies - Sour Blue Razz Lemonade
description:
Enjoy sweet n' sour with Double-Stacked Sour Blue Razz Lemonade gummies. This high-octane 2-pack packs a punch with 1,000mg per gummy, powered by a heavy-hitting blend of Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP. Experience a dual-layer flavor explosion that pairs electric, tart blue raspberry with a sharp, citrusy lemonade kick. Designed for those who want their potency served with a side of neon flavor—add this elite sour blend to your cart and feel the difference.

Sour Blue Razz Lemonade layers bold Blue Razz with refreshing Lemonade flavor, packing 2,000mg per bag and 1,000mg per gummy. Each gummy features a potent blend of THCP, Delta-9, and Delta-8 for a stacked BITEZ experience.
